title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：myth　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 myth 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the writer ① told the myth that no reader in the study would have recorded, and he said the telling was the whole of the month. The ② myth, meaning the tale itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a myth, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ myth in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ myth at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A myth, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the writer said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the myth was the whole of the matter, meaning the belief and not the tale. The ⑥ myth, meaning the belief and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; myth, he said, is either something you tell or the only word that means both a tale and a belief. He said the belief is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ myth had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ myth of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of recording; myth, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ myth I remember is the tale recorded in the manuscript, which closed in 1971 and is still recorded as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ myth, my mother said in 1973, is the only tale that improves by being recorded; every myth, she said, is a belief that has agreed to look like a tale. She said the belief was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 神话；虚构的事（指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 神话；虚构的事（指那个神话本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：tell the myth 讲这一个神话
D. n. 神话；虚构的事（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 神话之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的神话之事）
F. n. 神话；虚构的事（指手稿里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 神话、信念（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 信念（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: told the myth that no reader in the study would have recorded
The myth, meaning the tale itself and not the page
the myth at the far shelf
the myth was the whole of the matter
the myth had become a line in a manuscript
The myth of the whole thing
A myth, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: tell the myth 意为“讲这一个神话”，1964 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯记载的一个神话做了一遍。
myth 意为“神话；虚构的事”，指那个神话本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
myth 意为“神话；虚构的事”，指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
myth 意为“神话；虚构的事”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
myth 意为“神话、信念”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个信念就是那件事的全部。
myth 意为“信念”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个神话，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
myth 意为“神话；虚构的事”，指手稿里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1969 年这一个成了手稿里的一行。
myth 意为“神话之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的神话之事是一处书斋和三个月份的记载。
myth 意为“神话；虚构的事”，我记得的是手稿里记载过的那一个，1971 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一个。
myth 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，神话是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的神话。
